conclusion: No concrete blocker found in the frozen three-product delta and its focused tests.
checks: The existing bounded session tombstone retains an immutable release proof only after observed STOPPED, confirmed slot release, completed binding producers, no pending native request, lease hold or supersession.
The proof uses the SessionKey dictionary key and exact opening operation, stream epoch and original owner generation; no owner or epoch is guessed.
Claims are selected with the existing 257-row sentinel; epoch ambiguity examines at most two namespace-matching streams. Missing/ambiguous epoch or generation stays UNKNOWN.

A proof suppresses only the exact SESSION_RECONCILIATION_PENDING resource. Journal operations, ACK backlog, late handles, release obligations, outstanding producers, sink watermarks and truncated observations remain independently blocking.
Tombstone changes and capacity eviction increment the revision included in drain_revision. A change while the journal snapshot is awaited yields SNAPSHOT_CHANGED rather than confirmed quiescence.
Shared-journal composition accepts released proof only with a unique owner and complete matching tuple; duplicate release owners and simultaneous live/released owners are rejected.
Drain observation remains read-only. No new schema/migration, claim reconciliation, receipt mutation or ACK advancement was added.
After restart or loss/eviction of process-local proof, the historic pending claim remains UNKNOWN.
